names.note: The nominative the day page's own `/name/9674.html` link carries in its `title` and as that page's heading, «Матфий (Вознесенский), иерей, сщмч.», with the two trailing rank words left off. The surname in parentheses is part of the name and stays (BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2); the day's own line gives only «Сщмч. Матфия пресвитера (1919).» `fk.mjs` on this form returned NONE before the write. The same day prints a layman «Михаил (Вознесенский), мч.» of 1938 in another entry; the surname is shared and nothing read links the two men.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of its line for 19 мая ст. ст.: «Сщмч. Матфия пресвитера (1919).» His name page gives no year at all and no year of birth, and nothing was reckoned from anything.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 19 мая ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Матфия пресвитера (1919).»

attestations.note: **The line is all there is**, which BRIEF-RUSSIAN §2 makes a correct folder. The day page hangs no `/Life/` link on it; name page 9674 is a heading, the grade and two days, «26 января (Новомуч.) , 19 мая», and nothing else. The 26 января is the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia, a company's feast and not a second day of his own (BRIEF.md §8). He is the only entry of 1919 on this day, which is otherwise a day of 1938. azbyka.ru was not read, and it is the source that would turn this line into a life.
